subject: Hosted API commit tiers & rate protection terms (price lock / MFN / CPI)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbusretail.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API commit tiers & rate protection terms (price lock / MFN / CPI)

Hi Ellen and Ravi,

Thanks again for taking the demo last week — good conversation on latency SLAs and embedding throughput. Per our call, I wanted to put a clear proposal on commit tiers + protections to make procurement review quicker. Attached is a simple pricing spreadsheet (redwood-pricing-commit-tiers-v3.xlsx) with three suggested committed monthly spend tiers and the associated per-token unit price. High-level:

- Tier A: $10k/mo commit -> 10% discount off list per-token
- Tier B: $50k/mo commit -> 20% discount
- Tier C: $150k/mo commit -> 30% discount + dedicated capacity option

On rate protections: we can offer a price lock on the per-token rates for committed tiers (no unit price increases) for 12 months from the effective date. We tend to limit broad MFN clauses because they can hamper our ability to run public promotions and partner programs; however, we can accept a narrowly scoped MFN tied to like-for-like commercial terms (same model family, region, and commit tier) for the lock period.

Also happy to discuss a CPI-based adjustment cap for multi-year deals — for example a consumer price index cap of 3% annual maximum on list price adjustments outside the lock window.

If these guardrails look reasonable I can ask legal to start a tailored MSA and loop in finance for billing/payment terms. If you want a longer lock or broader MFN we’ll need to run that up to leadership.

Attached: redwood-pricing-commit-tiers-v3.xlsx

Next steps: please share procurement redlines or a shortlist of items you want to prioritize (e.g., price lock length, MFN scope, CPI cap). Happy to hop on a 30-min call this week.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0147

--

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbusretail.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@nimbusretail.com>, procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit tiers & rate protection terms (price lock / MFN / CPI)

Diego,

Thanks for the clear proposal and the spreadsheet — helpful. Procurement reviewed and has two primary asks before we can move forward to legal redlines:

1) Price lock: we require a 24-month firm price lock on committed unit pricing for budgeting purposes.
2) MFN: Nimbus requests an MFN clause for the duration of the commitment that ensures we get any materially better per-token pricing offered to comparable enterprise customers (same model, region, and committed volume).

We recognize MFNs can be sensitive; if Redwood needs carve-outs for public promotions, please identify those specifically. Also, procurement would prefer any CPI adjustments to be a ceiling of 2% annually (to protect our operating budget).

I've attached an initial redline summary (nimbus_msa_redlines_20260212.pdf) — it's a short list focused on price protections and invoicing cadence. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept 24 months or if we should aim for a compromise?

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Procurement
Nimbus Retail
ellen.park@nimbusretail.com

--

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus redlines re: price lock & MFN — need guidance

FYI — procurement is pushing for a 24-month price lock + a broad MFN + CPI cap 2%. They sent a short redline package (attached). My read: 24 months is longer than our standard (12), MFN as written is too broad and could capture marketplace promotions; CPI ceiling 2% is below our expectations.

Questions for legal and pricing:
- Is a limited MFN (same model family, same region, same committed tier) defensible?
- Would leadership accept 18 months if we add an annual true-up and exclude marketplace promotions?
- Can we offer a CPI cap at 3.5% as a compromise?

Attached: nimbus_msa_redlines_20260212.pdf, redwood-pricing-commit-tiers-v3.xlsx

Thanks — want to be thoughtful on concessions before I reply.

Diego
--

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nimbus redlines re: price lock & MFN — need guidance

Diego — quick guidance from pricing/legal:

- Push back on 24 months. Standard is 12 months. Offer a compromise at 18 months only for committed Tier B or above (>$50k/mo).
- MFN: we can accept a narrowly scoped MFN limited to like-for-like commercial terms (same model family, same region, same committed tier and term). Explicitly exclude public marketplace promotions, reseller channel discounts, and pilot credits.
- CPI cap: we can offer a 3.5% annual ceiling for any adjustments after the lock period, but not below market floors.

If they insist on broader MFN or 24 months across the board, escalate to sales leadership (I will engage CRO) — but try the 18-month/Tier B+ approach first.

I updated a negotiation playbook note (internal link) and can draft the concession language for legal to use in redlines.

— Lauren
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

--

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbusretail.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit tiers & rate protection terms (price lock / MFN / CPI)

Ellen / Ravi — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redlines. Appreciate the clarity on your constraints. After internal discussion we can offer the following compromise for Nimbus:

1) Price lock: 18 months firm price lock on per-token unit pricing for Tier B (>= $50k/mo) and Tier C (>= $150k/mo). Tier A remains a 12-month lock.
2) MFN: Redwood will accept a narrowly scoped MFN limited to like-for-like commercial terms (same model family, same region, same committed tier and term). We will expressly exclude: public marketplace promotions, reseller or channel-distributed discounts, and one-off trial/pilot credits.
3) CPI cap: 3.5% annual ceiling for adjustments after the lock period (we cannot accept 2%).

Additional notes: we’re open to an annual true-up clause to reconcile actual usage vs committed spend and to an addendum that documents the excluded promotion types. If this sounds acceptable I can ask legal to incorporate the language into the MSA and circulate a DocuSign.

I've attached the updated pricing workbook and included a short redline summary that reflects the compromise.

Next step: can you confirm if procurement can accept the 18-month lock for Tier B+ and the 3.5% CPI cap? If yes, I’ll trigger legal and send a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
--

From: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@nimbusretail.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbusretail.com>, procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit tiers & rate protection terms (price lock / MFN / CPI)

Diego — appreciate the flexibility. Nimbus can accept the compromise in principle: 18 months for Tier B/C, narrow MFN carve-outs, and 3.5% CPI cap. Procurement will pull final redlines to reflect the agreed scope and then we can move to signature. Our legal team will expect the MFN language to include a clear definition of "comparable customers"; we can draft that if helpful.

Please route the MSA to procurement@nimbusretail.com when ready and include a DocuSign link. Our budget code for the purchase order is NIM-CC-2026-045.

Ravi Shah
VP, Engineering Ops
Nimbus Retail
rav.i.shah@nimbusretail.com
